description: Defines owner-approved section-level authority for synchronizing shadow governance content into authoritative FORGE governance documents.
rules: Authority remains human unless a section is explicitly delegated.
Delegation applies only to the exact document and section identifier listed.
Each active delegation requires explicit owner approval.
Delegation does not override immutable-section, protected-content, capability, validation, or promotion policies.
An empty delegatedSections array grants no authoritative write authority.
The synchronizer must stop before writing when a requested section is not explicitly delegated.
